title: API Endpoints for Understanding, Context & Specification

extends_for_context.note: Context API endpoints are part of schema-context feature (c007, c008)

summary.goal: Add REST API endpoints for reading and updating understanding and step specifications
summary.context: Agents and UI need to incrementally update specific parts of understanding (per role) and specification (per step, per domain) without replacing the whole object. Context endpoints will be added as part of schema-context feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /plans/:id returns understanding in version response
GET /plans/:id returns specification in each step
PATCH /plans/:id/understanding/:role merges AgentObservations for that role
PATCH /plans/:id/steps/:stepId/specification/:domain merges DomainSpec for that domain
PATCH endpoints validate against Zod schemas, return 400 on invalid data
PATCH endpoints return the updated section, not full plan
Only draft status plans can have understanding/specification updated
SSE events emitted on understanding/specification changes

steps.title: Update GET /plans/:id response
steps.description: Ensure existing GET endpoint returns understanding and step specifications

acceptance_criteria.description: Response includes version.understanding (object or empty {})
Response includes version.steps[].specification for each step
Backward compatible: existing clients that ignore new fields continue to work

steps.title: Add PATCH /plans/:id/understanding/:role endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to update agent observations for a specific role

acceptance_criteria.description: Route: PATCH /api/plans/:id/understanding/:role
Request body: Partial<AgentObservations> (any subset of fields)
Merges with existing observations for that role (deep merge arrays)
Sets updated_at to current timestamp
Validates against AgentObservationsSchema, returns 400 on invalid
Returns 400 if plan status is not 'draft'
Response: { role: string, observations: AgentObservations }

steps.title: Add PATCH /plans/:id/steps/:stepId/specification/:domain endpoint
steps.description: Create endpoint to update specification for a specific step and domain

acceptance_criteria.description: Route: PATCH /api/plans/:id/steps/:stepId/specification/:domain
Domain param must be one of: architecture, design, testing, security
Request body: Partial<DomainSpec> for that domain
Merges with existing spec for that domain (deep merge arrays)
Validates against appropriate DomainSpecSchema, returns 400 on invalid
Returns 400 if plan status is not 'draft'
Returns 404 if step_id not found
Response: { step_id: string, domain: string, specification: DomainSpec }

steps.title: Add Zod request schemas
steps.description: Create Zod schemas for validating PATCH request bodies

acceptance_criteria.description: UpdateUnderstandingRequestSchema = AgentObservationsSchema.partial()
UpdateArchitectureSpecRequestSchema = ArchitectureSpecSchema.partial()
UpdateDesignSpecRequestSchema = DesignSpecSchema.partial()
UpdateTestingSpecRequestSchema = TestingSpecSchema.partial()
UpdateSecuritySpecRequestSchema = SecuritySpecSchema.partial()
PATCH /api/plans/:id/understanding/:role registered
PATCH /api/plans/:id/steps/:stepId/specification/:domain registered

steps.title: Emit SSE events on changes
steps.description: Emit plan_updated SSE event when understanding or specification changes

acceptance_criteria.description: PATCH understanding emits SSE event with type: 'understanding_updated'
PATCH specification emits SSE event with type: 'specification_updated'
Event includes plan_id, role/step_id/domain as applicable

steps.title: Add API endpoint tests
steps.description: Add integration tests for new endpoints

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: PATCH understanding adds observations for new role
Test: PATCH understanding merges with existing role observations
Test: PATCH understanding returns 400 for invalid data
Test: PATCH understanding returns 400 for non-draft plan
Test: PATCH specification adds spec to step
Test: PATCH specification merges with existing spec
Test: PATCH specification returns 404 for unknown step_id
Test: GET plan returns understanding and step specifications
